question: Should workspace schema version 1 permanently gain the optional layout field and full-layout widget-count invariant, accepting that documents written with layout are not readable by older strict schema readers?
rationale: Tests establish the new behavior, but only maintainers can define the persisted document's versioning and rollback guarantees.

options.title: Approve additive schema-v1 extension
options.body: Treat layout as a forward-compatible optional schema-v1 field, document the rollback limitation, and merge after refreshing proof on current main.

options.title: Version the workspace document
options.body: Introduce an explicit schema-version transition and focused upgrade coverage before exposing persisted layout.

options.title: Redesign without persisted layout
options.body: Pause this slice and place layout in an existing presentation-preference surface if persisted document compatibility is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve additive schema-v1 extension
recommendation.body: Treat layout as a forward-compatible optional schema-v1 field, document the rollback limitation, and merge after refreshing proof on current main.
